bots.name: Variance Explainer
bots.tagline: Computes the volume / price / mix bridge and writes commentary grounded only in those numbers.

steps.label: Close Sentinel succeeded
steps.result: Predecessor return value: period=2026-10

steps.label: Volume × price × mix bridge by segment
steps.sql:
SELECT segment,
  (act_visits - bud_visits) * bud_yield          AS volume_eff,
  (act_yield - bud_yield) * act_visits          AS price_eff,
  mix_eff, (act_occ - bud_occ) * rooms * bud_adr AS occupancy_eff
FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.V_VPM_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-10';
steps.result: Revenue EUR 299.1M vs 305.3M budget · largest driver: hotel occupancy −EUR 3.8M

steps.label: Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 0.5M)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.VPM_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 5e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
steps.result: 5 drivers — hotel occupancy, events timing, visits (UK), ticket mix, yield

steps.label: AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
steps.result: Commentary drafted (172 words) · numeric check: 10/10 figures match bridge

steps.label: Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
steps.result: Passed · 0 ungrounded figures

steps.label: Draft commentary to Variance (V×P×M) + CFO brief
steps.result: Draft published (badge: Written by Variance Explainer)

guardrails.label: Grounding
guardrails.rule: Every figure in the text must exist in the bridge result

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Only drivers above threshold are explained

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.T_VARIANCE_EXPLAINER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
AS
  CALL SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('variance-explainer');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Volume × price × mix bridge by segment
SELECT segment,
  (act_visits - bud_visits) * bud_yield          AS volume_eff,
  (act_yield - bud_yield) * act_visits          AS price_eff,
  mix_eff, (act_occ - bud_occ) * rooms * bud_adr AS occupancy_eff
FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.V_VPM_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-10';
-- step 3 · Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 0.5M)
SELECT * FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.VPM_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 5e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
-- step 4 · AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
SELECT AI_COMPLETE('claude-sonnet-4-5',
  'Write CFO commentary using ONLY these figures: ' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::STRING)
FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.VPM_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5;
-- step 5 · Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
SELECT SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.FN_NUMBERS_GROUNDED(:commentary, 'VPM_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5');
-- step 6 · Draft commentary to Variance (V×P×M) + CFO brief
INSERT INTO SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('variance-vpm', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');

-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.T_ROLLING_FORECAST
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('rolling-forecast');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST — daily visits per park × market

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.T_GL_MAPPER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/Paris'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('gl-mapper');

-- step 1 · Unmapped accounts detected
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 2 · AI_CLASSIFY against the management COA
SELECT account_code, AI_CLASSIFY(account_name || ' ' || sample_postings,
  (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(label) FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE is_leaf)) AS mapping
FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 3 · Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
SELECT * FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence < 0.92;
-- step 4 · Apply mappings + DMF on unmapped balance
INSERT INTO SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.PUBLIC.MAP_ACCOUNT SELECT ... FROM SDP_DISNEYLANDPARIS.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;
